subject.title: fix(codex): clean final/yield turn close writes a false "user interrupted" marker into the thread rollout

question: Should explicit Codex `final:true` and `sessions_yield` delivery wait up to 10 seconds for natural `turn/completed`, while a new inbound message immediately falls back to `turn/interrupt`?
rationale: This is a user-visible terminal-state policy tradeoff: it avoids false interruption context in the normal path but can retain turn bookkeeping briefly and still writes Codex’s interruption marker in fallback cases.

options.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
options.body: Keep the proposed 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound fallback after current-head live proof confirms the three close paths.

options.title: Keep immediate interruption
options.body: Retain existing hard-stop behavior if predictable immediate resolution is more important than avoiding the false interruption marker.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound fallback after current-head live proof confirms the three close paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the neighboring source-reply finalization behavior and is the strongest available history signal for this terminal-state choice.
